RAJYA SABHA
Thursday, the 12th May, 2016/22nd Vaisakha, 1938 (Saka)
The House met at eleven of the clock,  
MR. CHAIRMAN  in the Chair.  
OBITUARY REFERENCE
MR. CHAIRMAN: Hon. Members, I refer with profound sorrow to the passing 
away, this morning, of Shri Praveen Rashtrapal, a sitting Member of the House.
Born in December, 1939, in Gandhinagar District of Gujarat, Shri Rashtrapal 
was educated at the Siddharth College, Mumbai.
A civil servant, Shri Rashtrapal started his career as an Income Tax Inspector 
from 1969 to 1979 and rose to the post of Assistant Commissioner of Income Tax. 
He was a trade unionist and was actively associated with the trade union movement 
of Income Tax employees in particular and the Central Government employees in 
general.
He was the founder member of the Council for Social Justice and the Foundation 
for Dalit Literature. He also worked tirelessly in securing human rights to Dalits 
and justice to the poor and women. He also has a few publications to his credit. 
Shri Rashtrapal started his legislative career as a Member of the Thirteenth Lok 
Sabha from 1999 to 2004.
Shri Praveen Rashtrapal represented the State of Gujarat in this House from 
April, 2006 to April, 2012 and again from April, 2012 till his sad demise.
In the passing away of Shri Praveen Rashtrapal, the country has lost a distinguished 
parliamentarian, a noted trade unionist and a dedicated social worker.
We deeply mourn the passing away of Shri Praveen Rashtrapal. 
I request hon. Members to rise in their places and observe silence as a mark 
of respect to the memory of the departed.
(Hon. Members then sto od in silence for one minute )

2 Obituary [RAJYA SABHA] Reference
MR. CHAIRMAN: Secretary-General will convey to the members of the bereaved 
family our sense of profound sorrow and deep sympathy.
As a mark of respect to the memory of Shri Praveen Rashtrapal, sitting Member, 
the House stands adjourned till 11.00 a.m. on Friday, the 13th of May.
The House then adjourned at four minutes past
eleven of the clock till eleven of the clock on 
Friday, the 13th May 2016 .
